import hopsworks
import xgboost as xgb
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

fv = fs.get_feature_view('leakage_fv_f1', 1)
td = fv.get_training_data(1)

X = td[0][['f1']]
y = td[0]['label']

model = xgb.XGBClassifier(use_label_encoder=False, eval_metric='logloss')
model.fit(X, y)

y_pred = model.predict(X)
accuracy = accuracy_score(y, y_pred)

print(f'Accuracy for f1: {accuracy}')

mr = project.get_model_registry()
model_dir = 'f1_model'
model.booster().save_model(f'{model_dir}/model.json')

input_example = X.iloc[:1].to_json()
model_meta = mr.python.create_model('f1_model', metrics={'accuracy': accuracy}, input_example=input_example)
model_meta.save(model_dir)

awk -F, 'NR==1 {for (i=1; i<=NF; i++) col[i]=$i} NR>1 {for (i=2; i<=NF; i++) a[col[i]][NR]+=$i} END {for (i in a) {if (i != "label") {cmd="echo " a[i]["label"] " | awk \"{print \" i[1] \" - \" ($1 * $2) / (sqrt($3) * sqrt($4))}\" "; split(a[i]["f1"], x); split(a[i]["label"], y); n=length(x); sum_x=0; sum_y=0; sum_x2=0; sum_y2=0; sum_xy=0; for (k=1; k<=n; k++) {sum_x+=x[k]; sum_y+=y[k]; sum_x2+=x[k]*x[k]; sum_y2+=y[k]*y[k]; sum_xy+=x[k]*y[k]}; denom_x=sqrt(n*sum_x2 - sum_x*sum_x); denom_y=sqrt(n*sum_y2 - sum_y*sum_y); if (denom_x != 0 && denom_y != 0) print i, (n*sum_xy - sum_x*sum_y) / (denom_x * denom_y); else print i, 0}}}"' data/training_data.csv

awk -F, '{n++; sum_x+=$1; sum_y+=$2; sum_x2+=$1*$1; sum_y2+=$2*$2; sum_xy+=$1*$2} END {denom_x=sqrt(n*sum_x2 - sum_x*sum_x); denom_y=sqrt(n*sum_y2 - sum_y*sum_y); if (denom_x != 0 && denom_y != 0) print (n*sum_xy - sum_x*sum_y) / (denom_x * denom_y); else print 0}' f1_label.csv
